question: What’s the closest hotel as you travel from Go Fish, Rosedale, MD toward Strodes Mill Gallery, Inc., East Bradford Township, PA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.48474 39.339761)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-75.617434 39.92889)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'hotel'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.48474 39.339761)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.48474 39.339761)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[3].display_name: Strodes Mill Gallery, Inc., East Bradford Township, PA
